title: beautiful
text: beautiful. I bought this tile for an outside square of ground to create an tiny blue "pool"...  it is perfect and beautiful.  It is protected and I am hoping it will be around for a long, long time.  The art of the tile is unique and has a raised texture. It does have a fiber board type back and has a built in stand. The colors are really vibrant and the finish is super glossy. Perfect for my use.  I'm really happy with it!
